room.name: The Root That Stops the Stone

workshopRoutes.name: Make the stop, then remove it

room.question: When must the root stop the stone, and when must it disappear?
room.hint: Set blue before shoving the stone. The dash restores its amber stop. Reach the parked stone, ring the upper bell to open the root, then use the pod without removing the blue landing.

label: Root: recover a dash on the recreated amber shelf

room.name: The Dock You Need Only Once

workshopRoutes.name: Use the temporary dock, then send it onward

room.question: Why park the stone short of its final destination?
room.hint: Turn B down, then shove the stone to its temporary stop. Turn A into a bridge, use the stone to reach the far service ledge, and turn B left then up. Shove the stone onward; B now helps you reach its final dock.

label: Dock: reach far service without preparing machines
Dock: climb/dash from the near housing without moving stone
